heading: Organization of a government pursuant to a constitution
lead: Fully recognizing the principle of government by consent, sections 731b to 731e of this title are now adopted in the nature of a compact so that the people of Puerto Rico may organize a government pursuant to a constitution of their own adoption.

notes.text: Codification Section was not enacted as part of the Puerto Rican Federal Relations Act which comprises this chapter.
RepealsAct July 3, 1950, ch. 446, § 6, 64 Stat. 320, provided that: “All laws or parts of laws inconsistent with this Act [enacting sections 731b to 731e of this title] are hereby repealed.”
